acceptance_checks.check: Existing reference, VSM and decoded images copied with verified hashes
acceptance_checks.evidence: 3 reference PNGs, 13 decoded native PNGs, 3 VSM visualizations + lit baseline and 1 native screenshot; all sizes and SHA-256 values match their manifests.

acceptance_checks.check: Portable project and capture scripts packaged without build products or private logs
acceptance_checks.evidence: Minimal UnrealLab .uproject/Config/Source/map/materials plus 9 Python and 2 PowerShell portable scripts; no Binaries, Intermediate, DerivedDataCache, Saved, stdout/stderr or UnrealLab.log; EngineRoot is a mandatory parameter.

acceptance_checks.check: Native resource inventory and known gaps retained honestly
acceptance_checks.evidence: All 1389 resources, 928 passes and 2481 resource-file records retained (14,517,078,510 bytes); 105 descriptor-only records, 78 Texture3D, 3 TextureCube, 24 SkipTracking warnings and the LumenCardScene RDG UB mapping gap are explicit.

known_gaps.detail: All 78 Texture3D resources are descriptor-only. DumpGPU's TranslateSubresourceDumpDesc fills extents only for Texture2D, so no 3D texture bytes exist in Resources/. Descriptors remain in inventory.json.
All 3 TextureCube resources are descriptor-only for the same IsTexture2D gate. Descriptors remain in inventory.json; face bytes are not present.

24 warning lines record DefaultStructuredBuffer, DefaultByteAddressBuffer, DefaultBuffer and VirtualTexture_FeedbackBuffer skipped because of ERDGBufferFlags::SkipTracking. Exact warning lines are retained in missing-coverage.json.

This export retains pass parameter payloads and StructuresMetadata for shader structures including LumenCardScene, but it does not provide an exact mapping from every RDG uniform-buffer payload to the corresponding RDG resource. Source instrumentation is expected to close this in later data. No such mapping is claimed here.
Only resources referenced by an RDG pass are discoverable. RHI-external resources, never-viewed resources, swapchain/backbuffer state and driver-private allocations are absent.
DumpGPU captures resources and pass parameter payloads, not registers or values local to a shader invocation. Shader source mapping is evidence, not a memory capture.
Passes.json names resource versions bound to passes; it is not a full descriptor-heap or SRV/UAV view dump.
When a resource is modified in place, later passes link to the one dumped producer version rather than per-read duplicates. Passes.json preserves the version linkage.
Depth/stencil and sub-4-byte textures are copied through a staging preprocess; stored bytes are the postprocessed format, not native RHI layout.
r.DumpGPU.Upload=0 and r.DumpGPU.Explore=0; nothing was uploaded or opened. Raw dump path is external and not included.

native.coverage_statement: This package retains the complete DumpGPU resource/pass inventory for the native attempt, but makes no claim of exhaustive computational coverage. The known omissions above remain.

reference.images: lumen-lit.png, pathtracer-256spp-8bounces.png and pathtracer-1024spp-8bounces.png, all 1280x720 display-referred PNGs with manifest hashes.
reference.sample_indices: 256 spp / 8 bounces / denoiser 0 and 1024 spp / 8 bounces / denoiser 0; engine sample index and reported count both equal 256 or 1024. 256 samples accumulated across about 86 draw requests.
reference.light: Ceiling area light, 2400 lumens, 130x120 cm, attenuation radius 1000 cm (saved map value; the old 2000 cm request was not rebuilt).
reference.exposure: histogram AEM_HISTOGRAM pinned by min_brightness == max_brightness == EV100 4 and bias 0; not manual exposure mode.

exclusions: published original image and original source-reference tree (optional, not required)
